components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn { min-height: 46px; padding: 0 18px; border: 0; border-radius: 14px; background: #0D9488; color: #04201C; font-weight: 700; box-shadow: 0 10px 24px -12px rgba(13,148,136,.8); }

components.name: Stat Card
components.description: A money figure with its label.
components.css: .ds-card { display: grid; gap: 6px; padding: 22px; border: 1px solid rgba(14,26,34,.09); border-radius: 20px; background: #fff; } .ds-card small { color: #557080; } .ds-card strong { font-size: 30px; font-weight: 650; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
